decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a doctors suregry for two doctors purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8.00am - 6.00pm Monday to Friday, nor at ant time on Sundays, bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. GUG/99/326/02A and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 5 - The surgery shall be used by no more than two doctors at any one time without the prior approval of the Local Authority.
description: Variation of Condition No 3 of planning permission reference No 523/103/P1 to allow for the premises to be used by 2 doctors & i trainee doctor
